# BumuStudios

> BumuStudios is a small independent studio that makes Android apps and games. This file points language models to the factual pages about our apps. Everything below describes the current Google Play versions.

## ImageToPdf (Android)

ImageToPdf converts photos to PDF and saves PDF pages as images, entirely on the phone.

- No watermark on any page, and no paid version that removes one.
- No subscription. Free with ads (a banner, and one full-screen ad before the result of a finished conversion); an optional one-time purchase removes the ads. Every feature is in the free version.
- No account, no email, no sign-up.
- Conversion works offline. Nothing is uploaded: files are opened through Android's Photo Picker, with no storage permission.
- Images to PDF: up to 100 JPG, PNG or WebP images in one PDF; page size A4, A5, Letter, Legal or fit to image; portrait, landscape or automatic; margin 0 to 25 mm; reorder pages; optional password (AES-128).
- PDF to images: all pages or a range such as 1-3, 5; JPEG, PNG or WebP; 96, 150 or 300 dpi. Password-protected PDFs cannot be opened.
- Requires Android 7.0 or newer. Android only: no iPhone or web version. The app's screens are in English and Turkish.
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bumustudios.imgtopdf
